meanings.def: feeling fear; scared
worried about a result (I'm afraid I can't come)

examples: The little boy was afraid of the dark.
She was afraid to speak in front of the class.
I'm afraid the shop is already closed.

meanings.def: to have the same opinion as someone
to say yes to a plan or request

examples: I agree with you about the movie.
Both sides agreed to meet on Friday.
He never agrees to anything quickly.

meanings.def: feeling strong displeasure or rage
(of a sky or sea) dark and stormy

examples: Dad was angry when he saw the broken window.
Don't get angry over a small mistake.
The angry sea crashed against the rocks.

meanings.def: to reach a place at the end of a journey
to come at a particular moment

examples: The train arrives at six o'clock.
We arrived late because of the traffic.
Spring has finally arrived.

meanings.def: to use force to hurt someone or something
a sudden sharp criticism or a bout of illness

examples: The wolves attacked the sheep at night.
The newspaper made a harsh attack on the mayor.
He had an attack of coughing.

meanings.def: the lowest part of something
last in rank or position

examples: The keys fell to the bottom of the bag.
She sat at the bottom of the stairs.
Our team is at the bottom of the table.

meanings.def: quick at learning and understanding
skillfully designed or done

examples: She is a clever girl who solves puzzles fast.
That was a clever way to fix the lock.
The clever fox tricked the crow.

meanings.def: causing pain or suffering without pity
harsh and painful (a cruel winter)

examples: It is cruel to keep a bird in a tiny cage.
The king was cruel to his servants.
They survived a cruel winter in the mountains.

meanings.def: after a long time or delay
as the last point in a list

examples: After hours of waiting, the bus finally came.
Finally, I would like to thank my teacher.
She finally understood the lesson.

meanings.def: to put something where it cannot be seen
to keep a feeling or fact secret

examples: The children hid behind the sofa.
He tried to hide his disappointment.
Squirrels hide nuts for the winter.

meanings.def: to chase animals to catch or kill them
to search hard for something

examples: Lions hunt in groups at dusk.
I hunted everywhere for my glasses.
The police are hunting for the thief.

meanings.def: a large number or amount (a lot of)

examples: There are a lot of books on the shelf.
He spends a lot of time reading.

meanings.def: the central point or part
in the centre between two ends

examples: She stood in the middle of the room.
He woke up in the middle of the night.
I sat in the middle seat.

meanings.def: a very short period of time
a particular point in time

examples: Wait a moment, please.
At that moment, the phone rang.
It was a moment I will never forget.

meanings.def: happy and satisfied
glad about a particular event

examples: The teacher was pleased with my progress.
I am pleased to meet you.
She looked pleased with her new bag.

meanings.def: to say you will definitely do something
a sign that something good may come

examples: I promise to call you tonight.
He broke his promise to his friend.

meanings.def: to answer in speech or writing
an answer given to a question or message

examples: She did not reply to my message.
He replied that he was busy.
I am waiting for a reply from the school.

meanings.def: protected from danger or harm
not likely to cause harm

examples: The children are safe at home.

meanings.def: an act meant to fool someone
a clever skill or technique

examples: The magician showed us a card trick.
It was just a trick to get my attention.

meanings.def: in a good or skillful way
a deep hole dug to reach water

examples: She plays the piano very well.
I did not sleep well last night.
The villagers drew water from the well.

meanings.def: an exciting or unusual experience
a risky journey or activity

examples: Their trip to the jungle was a real adventure.
The book is full of adventure.
He loves adventure and travels alone.

meanings.def: to come near in distance or time
a way of dealing with a problem

examples: The dog slowly approached the stranger.
Winter is approaching fast.
She has a new approach to learning words.

meanings.def: with close attention to avoid mistakes
gently so as not to cause damage

examples: Read the question carefully before you answer.
He carried the glass carefully across the room.
Drive carefully on wet roads.

meanings.def: a substance made by or used in chemistry
relating to chemistry

examples: Cleaning products contain strong chemicals.
The factory polluted the river with chemicals.
A chemical reaction made the mixture fizz.

meanings.def: to make something new
to cause something to happen

examples: The artist created a huge painting.
Her song created a happy mood.
They want to create a new garden.

meanings.def: morally bad and harmful
wickedness or harm in general

examples: The evil witch cursed the village.

He had an evil plan to steal the gold.

meanings.def: a scientific test to find out something
to try new ideas or methods

examples: We did an experiment with magnets in class.

The scientist repeated the experiment twice.

meanings.def: to cause the death of a person or animal
to put an end to something (kill time)

examples: Frost can kill young plants.

meanings.def: a room where scientific work is done
a place where medicines or products are tested

Samples were sent to the laboratory.

meanings.def: to make sounds that show amusement
the sound or act of laughing

She has a loud, happy laugh.

meanings.def: producing a lot of sound

He has a loud voice.
She wore a loud orange jacket.

meanings.def: worried or a little afraid

examples: I felt nervous before the exam.

meanings.def: a loud or unpleasant sound
any sound, especially an unwanted one

examples: The noise from the street woke me up.
Please don't make any noise.
The engine made a strange noise.

meanings.def: a planned piece of work
to throw or show an image onto a surface

examples: Our class is doing a project on space.
The building project will take two years.
The film was projected onto the wall.

meanings.def: to make someone feel afraid
a sudden feeling of fright

examples: The thunder scared the puppy.
You gave me a scare!

meanings.def: something kept hidden from others
not known or seen by others

examples: Can you keep a secret?
They found a secret door in the wall.
It is a secret recipe from my grandmother.

meanings.def: to say something very loudly
a loud cry or call

examples: Don't shout at the baby.
He shouted for help.
We heard a shout from the garden.

meanings.def: to notice something with the nose
the quality that you notice with your nose

examples: I can smell fresh bread.
The flowers have a sweet smell.
The room smelled of smoke.

meanings.def: very bad or unpleasant
causing great fear or shock

examples: We had terrible weather on holiday.
The accident was a terrible shock.
She felt terrible after the long trip.

meanings.def: of lower quality than something else
more ill or unwell than before

examples: The weather is worse than yesterday.
His cough got worse at night.

meanings.def: a creature from another planet
strange or not familiar (an alien place)

examples: The movie is about an alien who visits Earth.

meanings.def: in the middle of a group
being one of many

examples: The cat hid among the boxes.
She is among the best students in class.

meanings.def: a drawing that shows facts or numbers
a map for ships or planes

examples: The chart shows how much rain fell each month.
The teacher put a chart on the wall.
The pilot checked the chart before the flight.

meanings.def: a white or grey mass of tiny water drops in the sky
a group of small things in the air (a cloud of dust)

examples: Dark clouds mean rain is coming.
A cloud of smoke rose from the fire.
The sky was clear, with no cloud at all.

meanings.def: to understand something
to take in the full meaning of a hard idea

examples: I can't comprehend this math problem.
Children comprehend stories better with pictures.
He could not comprehend why she was upset.

meanings.def: to tell what someone or something is like
to explain how something happened

examples: Can you describe your new teacher?
She described the accident to the police.
Describe your day in three sentences.

meanings.def: at any time
always (forever)

examples: Have you ever eaten sushi?
This is the best pizza ever.
They lived happily ever after.

meanings.def: to not pass a test
to not work or not succeed

examples: I studied hard so I would not fail the exam.
The car failed to start this morning.
Don't be afraid to fail; try again.

meanings.def: kind and pleasant to others
easy to use or good for something (kid-friendly)

examples: Our neighbour is very friendly.
The friendly dog came to say hello.

meanings.def: a mark you get for school work
a school year or level

examples: I got a good grade in English.
My sister is in fifth grade.
Teachers grade the tests every week.

meanings.def: in place of something else
as another choice

examples: We had no milk, so I drank tea instead.
Let's walk instead of taking the bus.
He wanted to play, but she studied instead.

meanings.def: a place where you can borrow books
a collection of books at home

examples: I borrow books from the library every week.
The library is quiet, so don't shout.
Dad has a small library in his room.

meanings.def: a large round object that moves around a star
the Earth, our home

examples: Mars is a red planet.
We must take care of our planet.
There are eight planets in our solar system.

meanings.def: a piece of writing or talk that gives facts
to tell someone in charge about something

examples: I wrote a report about dolphins.
The news report said it will rain.
Please report any problem to the teacher.

meanings.def: more than two but not many
different or separate (several ways)

examples: I waited for several minutes.
She has several friends in this town.
There are several ways to get there.

meanings.def: to find the answer to a problem
to fix something that is wrong

examples: He solved the puzzle in ten minutes.
Let's solve this problem together.
Talking can solve many arguments.

meanings.def: quickly and without warning
all at once

examples: Suddenly, the lights went out.
The dog suddenly ran across the road.
It suddenly started to rain.

meanings.def: to think something is probably true
to ask someone to imagine something

examples: I suppose he is at home.
Suppose you won a prize, what would you do?
I suppose we should leave now.

meanings.def: all of space and everything in it
everything that exists

examples: The universe has billions of stars.
He wants to study the universe.
Our planet is a tiny part of the universe.

meanings.def: what you can see from a place
your opinion or way of thinking

examples: The hotel room has a lovely view of the sea.
In my view, the film was too long.
We climbed up to enjoy the view.

meanings.def: right or suitable for a situation
correct for a purpose

examples: Wear clothes that are appropriate for the weather.
That joke is not appropriate at school.
Choose an appropriate gift for her.

meanings.def: to stay away from something
to try not to do something

examples: I avoid sweets because they hurt my teeth.
Leave early to avoid the traffic.
He avoided answering my question.

meanings.def: to act in a polite or proper way
to act in a certain way

examples: Please behave well at the party.
The children behaved nicely in class.
He behaves like a baby when he is tired.

meanings.def: quiet and not worried
without wind or big waves

examples: Stay calm and don't panic.
The sea was calm this morning.
She spoke in a calm voice.

meanings.def: a feeling of worry about something
something that matters to you

examples: The doctor showed concern for his health.
My main concern is the cost.
Parents have a concern about safety.

meanings.def: happy and satisfied
the things inside something (the content of a book)

examples: She felt content with a simple life.
Read the content of the letter carefully.
The video has fun content for kids.

meanings.def: to think something will happen
to wait for someone or something to come

examples: I expect it will be cold tomorrow.
We are expecting guests tonight.
Don't expect me to wake up early.

meanings.def: often
many times

examples: She frequently visits her grandmother.
It rains frequently in this town.
He frequently forgets his keys.

meanings.def: something you do often without thinking
a regular way of acting

examples: Brushing your teeth is a good habit.
Biting nails is a bad habit.
He has a habit of waking up early.

meanings.def: to teach someone a skill
to tell someone what to do

examples: She instructs children to swim.
The teacher instructed us to open our books.
The sign instructs drivers to slow down.

meanings.def: a problem or topic that people talk about
one copy of a magazine or newspaper

examples: Money is a big issue for many families.
There is an issue with my phone.
I bought the latest issue of the magazine.

meanings.def: not any
not one person or thing

examples: None of the cookies are left.
I asked for help, but none came.
None of my friends live nearby.

meanings.def: able to wait calmly
a person who is getting medical care

examples: Be patient, the food will come soon.
The doctor is seeing a patient now.
A good teacher is patient with children.

meanings.def: hopeful and thinking of good things
sure and certain

examples: Try to stay positive when things are hard.
She has a positive attitude.
I'm positive I locked the door.

meanings.def: to make someone suffer for doing wrong
to give a penalty for breaking a rule

examples: Parents should not punish children too hard.
The school punishes students who cheat.
He was punished for being late.

meanings.def: to stand for something
to speak or act for someone else

examples: The red light represents danger.
She represents our class in the contest.
The flag represents our country.

meanings.def: to move quickly up and down or side to side
to tremble from fear, cold or anger

examples: Shake the bottle before you drink.
He shook my hand and smiled.
My hands shake when I am cold.

meanings.def: to open something out over a surface
to move to more people or places

examples: Spread butter on the bread.
The news spread fast in school.
A cold can spread quickly in winter.

meanings.def: to walk slowly and happily
a slow, relaxed walk

examples: We strolled along the beach after dinner.
Grandpa loves an evening stroll.
Let's take a stroll in the park.

meanings.def: a small town in the countryside
the people who live in a small town

examples: My grandparents live in a small village.
The village has one shop and a school.
The whole village came to the festival.

meanings.def: knowing that something exists
paying attention to what is around you

examples: Are you aware that the shop is closed today?
He was not aware of the danger.
Be aware of cars when you cross the road.

meanings.def: in a poor way
very much or seriously

examples: He played badly and lost the game.
She was badly hurt in the fall.
I badly need a rest.

meanings.def: to be owned by someone
to be part of a group or place

examples: This bag belongs to my sister.
Do you belong to a football club?
These books belong on the top shelf.

meanings.def: to keep doing something without stopping
to start again after a break

examples: Please continue reading from page ten.
The rain continued all night.
We will continue after lunch.

meanings.def: a mistake
a problem on a computer screen

examples: I found an error in my homework.
The phone showed an error message.
It was a small error, so don't worry.

meanings.def: things you have done and learned over time
something that happens to you

examples: She has five years of experience as a cook.
Our trip was a wonderful experience.

meanings.def: a large open area of grass or crops
a place where sports are played

examples: Cows are eating grass in the field.
The boys play football on the field.
My uncle works in the rice fields.

meanings.def: to cause pain to someone
to feel sad because of what someone said

examples: I hurt my knee when I fell.
His words hurt her feelings.
My head hurts after the long day.

meanings.def: an opinion after thinking about something
the ability to make good choices

examples: I trust your judgment about this plan.

meanings.def: probably going to happen
seeming true or possible

examples: It is likely to rain this evening.

meanings.def: usual and expected
healthy and without problems

examples: It is normal to feel nervous before a test.

meanings.def: not found or seen often
cooked so the middle is still red (rare meat)

meanings.def: to rest and feel calm
to become less tight or tense

examples: I relax by listening to music.

meanings.def: a polite ask for something
to ask for something politely

examples: I made a request for a day off.

meanings.def: to live in a place
to stay in a place for a long time

examples: They reside in a small flat near the park.

meanings.def: what happens because of something
the final score or answer

meanings.def: to move by turning over and over
to wrap something into a round shape

examples: The ball rolled down the hill.

meanings.def: from a past time until now

meanings.def: able to be seen

examples: The stars are visible on clear nights.

meanings.def: living in nature, not owned by people
not controlled or very excited

examples: Wild monkeys live in the forest.
